repos.name: AutoTableCharts
repos.one_liner: A Swift package that deterministically recommends and renders semantically safe charts from typed tabular data.
techniques: Semantic validation of column provenance, aggregation, and composition policies
Strongly typed immutable datasets with validated row and column identities
Foundation-only analysis and preparation separated from SwiftUI presentation
Validated and bounded chart recommendation catalogs
Shared caching with synchronous lookup, trimming, and statistics
Observable session lifecycle management with cancellation, retries, supersession, and warm cache adoption
Presentation-time localization, formatting, accessibility, and selection semantics
Swift result builders for domain-model dimension, measure, identifier, and interval declarations
repos.what_it_does: It validates typed tabular datasets, analyzes column semantics, produces bounded chart recommendation catalogs, prepares marks while preserving caller-defined row identities, and renders selections through a separate SwiftUI and Swift Charts product. It operates offline without row sampling or mutation of caller storage, and provides shared caching plus observable sessions for cancellation, retries, supersession, and lifecycle orchestration.

repos.name: Bricky
repos.one_liner: Native iOS instruction guide and AR recovery assistant for authored LDraw models.
techniques: LDraw MPD and stepped LDR parsing
On-device computer vision and vision-language inference with MLX
Golden-manifest and snapshot testing with Python and pyldraw3
repos.what_it_does: Imports MPD or stepped LDR models, renders deterministic 3D and AR instructions from authored STEP and ROTSTEP data, manually aligns a virtual model with a physical LEGO build, and uses three guided camera views with an on-device pinned MLX vision-language model to recover the last completed step. It stores metadata with SwiftData and keeps model and image files in application support.

repos.name: Directory-SwiftUI
repos.one_liner: A SwiftUI directory demo application with local persistence and API-backed data synchronization.
techniques: Image loading and caching with Kingfisher
repos.what_it_does: Displays a directory-style interface, requests remote data with Alamofire, synchronizes API results into Core Data, and loads and caches images with Kingfisher. It includes light and dark interface examples, an animated gradient background, and typed access to SF Symbols.

repos.name: FlowDelta
repos.one_liner: Deterministic Swift library and CLI that explains how Git changes affect program control and data flow.
repos.what_it_does: Parses Swift, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, and Go into normalized syntax trees, matches declarations and syntax across revisions, builds statement-level control-flow graphs, and reports matched graph deltas. It supports lexical intraprocedural def-use analysis and backward slicing for Swift and TypeScript/JavaScript, source-derived call neighborhoods with optional IndexStoreDB enrichment for Swift, native AppKit review views, and table, JSON, Mermaid, and Markdown exports.

repos.name: Foundation-Models-and-Core-AI-and-MLX-skills
repos.one_liner: Evidence-backed documentation and agent-skill corpus for Apple’s 2026 on-device AI technologies.
techniques: SDK interface capture with provenance hashes
repos.what_it_does: Provides a canonical 17-part guide series covering Apple Foundation Models, Core AI, MLX, evaluations, speech, App Intents, Metal tensor operations, deployment, and platform migration. It generates ten portable agent skills from the guides, maintains API and silent-failure indexes, records evidence provenance and confidence states, runs Python validation and Swift runtime probes, supports SDK-interface and snippet verification on macOS, publishes an MkDocs site, and includes workflows for evidence freshness and reproducible research mirrors.

repos.name: HighlightKit
repos.one_liner: Pure Swift, highlight.js-compatible syntax-highlighting library for Apple platforms.
repos.what_it_does: Highlights source code in 71 languages and returns UTF-16 NSRange tokens or native NSAttributedString output. It supports automatic and repository-aware language detection, typed and adaptive themes, custom grammars, caching, bounded overlay rendering, and incremental re-highlighting for editors. Token fidelity is tested against pinned reference fixtures.

repos.name: PartyBox
repos.one_liner: A local-network living-room party game in which an Apple TV or Mac hosts and up to eight iPhones serve as controllers.
techniques: Binary UDP real-time input at 60 Hz
repos.what_it_does: Provides five multiplayer games, optional bots, a three-event Party Cup with persistent trophies, and touch or calibrated motion controls. It discovers hosts through Bonjour, sends control data over JSON/TCP and 60 Hz input over UDP with TCP fallback, and keeps game state authoritative on the host. It also includes a reusable network fault-proxy library and CLI plus local build, test, sanitizer, and soak verification tooling.

repos.name: WanderWall
repos.one_liner: Android app that automatically updates the BOOX Note Air 3C lock screen from a predefined image URL.
techniques: Timestamped filenames to force wallpaper refresh
repos.what_it_does: Periodically downloads an image from a configured URL and places it in BOOX-specific filesystem locations for use as the lock-screen or power-off image. It is intended to keep information such as weekly tasks and reminders visible without relying on the BOOX cloud wallpaper service. The app requires extensive filesystem access and currently has known issues involving disabled networking while locked, accumulating timestamped downloads, and hardcoded defaults.

repos.name: agent-web-search
repos.one_liner: A client-first TypeScript library that queries and aggregates multiple web search providers for AI agents.
repos.what_it_does: Provides a normalized interface for 14 built-in search engines, isolates per-provider failures, supports parallel, race, fallback, and hedged execution, and streams results or answer deltas. It deduplicates canonical URLs, combines rankings with reciprocal rank fusion, formats output as LLM-ready Markdown or XML, enforces throttling, rate-limit awareness, deadlines, cancellation, and cost budgets, and supports custom provider adapters. It also supplies integrations for Anthropic, OpenAI function calling, the Vercel AI SDK, a command-line interface, and an MCP stdio server.

repos.name: ai-roi-mcm-npv-marimo
repos.one_liner: Interactive Monte Carlo analysis of the net present value and risk of AI implementation initiatives.
repos.what_it_does: Models four AI benefit categories—automation time savings, bug reduction, faster product delivery, and employee retention—under uncertain assumptions. A browser-based Marimo notebook provides adjustable parameters and displays NPV distributions, annual benefit breakdowns, positive-NPV probability, 90% confidence intervals, correlations, and percentile summaries.

repos.name: ai-sdk-provider-grok-build
repos.one_liner: Community Vercel AI SDK v7 provider that exposes the Grok Build CLI as a LanguageModelV4.
techniques: Vercel AI SDK v7 LanguageModelV4 provider
Child-process execution of the Grok CLI
Agent Client Protocol over newline-delimited JSON-RPC
repos.what_it_does: Wraps the local Grok CLI for AI SDK text generation, streaming, and structured output. It provides a stateless process-per-call exec mode and a persistent ACP agent mode with token-level streaming, resumable sessions, tool-call visibility, and permission handling. It also exposes settings for reasoning effort, sandboxing, permissions, tools, web search, authentication, and binary resolution.

repos.name: ai-sdk-react-model-picker
repos.one_liner: Theme-aware React model picker for Vercel AI SDK v5 applications and IDE extensions.
techniques: Provider registry and extensible provider abstractions
Local Ollama and LM Studio model discovery
repos.what_it_does: Provides TypeScript React components and APIs for selecting, configuring, and persisting AI models and providers. It supports extensible provider registration and validation, role-based model selection, pluggable storage, local Ollama and LM Studio model detection, custom styling, and environment-aware themes for web, VSCode, and JetBrains integrations.

repos.name: ai-yoga-coach
repos.one_liner: A Python project with no documented functionality.
repos.what_it_does: The available evidence only establishes Python source code and a pyproject.toml configuration file; its behavior and capabilities are unclear.

repos.name: amazon-to-sqlite
repos.one_liner: Imports Amazon data exports into SQLite for SQL and Datasette exploration.
techniques: Automated testing, linting, formatting, and static type checking
repos.what_it_does: Provides a Python command-line tool that discovers and imports Amazon order-history and related CSV exports into normalized SQLite tables. It deduplicates repeated imports, normalizes dates, money, and unavailable values, creates useful indexes and optional FTS5 product search, bundles Datasette queries, and can perform best-effort checks for alternative book formats on Amazon.com.

repos.name: ambientweather2sqlite
repos.one_liner: Locally records AmbientWeather station observations in SQLite and optionally exposes them through HTTP, MQTT, and monitoring integrations.
techniques: Local subnet scanning and HTTP device discovery
SQLite WAL storage with dynamic sensor columns
Versioned database migration with automatic backups
HTTP JSON API with bearer-token authentication and CORS
MQTT publishing and Home Assistant discovery
Rotating logs and graceful process shutdown
repos.what_it_does: A dependency-free Python CLI and daemon discovers an AmbientWeather station on the local network, polls its live HTML readings, and stores deduplicated observations in a dynamically evolving SQLite schema. It provides configuration, status, export, backup, migration, and metadata commands; an authenticated JSON and Prometheus-compatible HTTP server; Home Assistant MQTT discovery; outage webhooks; automatic station rediscovery; and Docker, macOS launchd, and Linux systemd deployment support.

repos.name: android-studio-sharedprefs-from-data-class
repos.one_liner: Sunset Android Studio plugin that generates SharedPreferences reader and writer classes from Kotlin data classes.
repos.what_it_does: Adds a “Generate SharedPrefs” action to Android Studio’s code-generation menu. When invoked inside a Kotlin data class, it generates a SharedPreferences reader/writer class based on that data class’s fields. The project is sunset and will receive no future updates.

repos.name: angular-miller-column-browser
repos.one_liner: An AngularJS plugin for browsing hierarchical data with Miller columns.
repos.what_it_does: Provides a column-browser directive that displays hierarchical JSON data in resizable Miller columns, supports AJAX and preloaded data, and offers customizable preview-pane and toolbar callbacks. Keyboard navigation is documented as forthcoming.

repos.name: angular-rest-api-browser
repos.one_liner: An AngularJS web application for browsing REST APIs through a column-based interface.
repos.what_it_does: Provides a browser-based, flexible column UI for exploring REST APIs. It runs as a client-side application served from static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files and includes a local development server and tests.

repos.name: app-store-updates-to-sqlite
repos.one_liner: A Python CLI that polls current iOS App Store releases and preserves observed update history in SQLite.
repos.what_it_does: It queries Apple's public lookup endpoint for configured app IDs in the United States storefront, storing release versions, dates, notes, App Store URLs, SHA-256 content hashes, and observation timestamps. It records version transitions as append-only events, retains metadata changes for unchanged versions as revisions, tracks the latest app state, and reports complete or partial polling failures with nonzero exit codes.

repos.name: ar-disc-golf
repos.one_liner: Installable mobile web app for GPS-guided disc golf with live scoring and AR basket navigation.
repos.what_it_does: Lets players select, create, import, and share disc golf courses; navigate holes using GPS maps and an AR directional arrow; track throws, scores, and hole progression; and save round history locally. It also supports offline cached map tiles, wake lock, simulated play when location is unavailable, and WebXR with an AR.js fallback.

repos.name: attio-ts-sdk
repos.one_liner: Type-safe TypeScript SDK for the Attio CRM API with Zod v4 runtime validation and higher-level client helpers.
techniques: Zod v4 runtime request and response validation
Typed filters, value factories, identifiers, and metadata-derived schemas
Normalized error hierarchy with fuzzy-match suggestions
Offset- and cursor-based pagination with async streaming
Metadata caching with TTL, capacity limits, and adapter support
repos.what_it_does: Provides generated access to Attio API endpoints plus convenience APIs for CRM objects, records, lists, notes, tasks, files, search, workspace members, and metadata. It validates requests and responses, normalizes records and errors, handles retries and rate limits, supports cancellation, caching, filtering, pagination, streaming, batch record retrieval, schema-aware values, and typed value accessors.

repos.name: attio-tui
repos.one_liner: A terminal user interface for browsing and managing Attio CRM data.
techniques: Unit, component, and PTY integration testing with Vitest, ink-testing-library, and node-pty
repos.what_it_does: Provides a three-pane terminal application for navigating companies, people, notes, tasks, meetings, and webhooks in Attio. It supports Vim-style keyboard navigation, command search, configurable columns, record detail views, clipboard copying, JSON export, browser links, webhook creation and editing, runtime diagnostics, configuration validation, and an accessible screen-reader mode.

repos.name: awesome-ai-tools-for-programmers-not-coding
repos.one_liner: A curated list of AI tools for software engineering tasks other than code generation.
repos.what_it_does: Catalogs and links to AI-assisted tools for repository diagramming and analysis, pull-request review, and software testing, with a project-management category listed but not evidenced with entries.

repos.name: awesome-android-lint
repos.one_liner: Curated directory of Android lint rules, documentation, and related Kotlin analysis tools.
repos.what_it_does: Organizes links to custom and built-in Android lint checks, guides for configuring and authoring lint rules, and related tools such as Detekt, Ktlint, and an IDE extension.

repos.name: awesome-falsehood-skill
repos.one_liner: An agent skill for identifying fragile assumptions about real-world data in software designs and code.
techniques: Automated source retrieval with Wayback Machine fallback
repos.what_it_does: Provides citation-keyed, on-demand topic digests for reviewing schemas, validators, parsers, APIs, data models, tests, migrations, UX flows, and integrations. It covers contact data, geography, identity, measurement, money, software systems, internationalized text, time, and web/network behavior. Supporting Python scripts rebuild a source corpus, validate the packaged skill, and compare its reference index with the upstream Awesome Falsehood list; tests and CI verify the tooling and skill.

repos.name: awesome-flipper-plugins
repos.one_liner: A curated directory of plugins for the Flipper debugging tool.
repos.what_it_does: Catalogs Android and React Native Flipper plugins for inspecting application lifecycles, storage, databases, network payloads, threads, logs, state, navigation, and performance, with links to their source repositories.

repos.name: awesome-gemini-code-styleguide
repos.one_liner: Copyable coding style guides for customizing Gemini Code Assist behavior.
repos.what_it_does: Provides project-ready style-guide templates for TypeScript, Next.js with TypeScript, and Python, intended to be copied into a project's .gemini/styleguide.md file and modified as needed.

repos.name: base91-kotlin-multiplatform
repos.one_liner: Kotlin Multiplatform library for Base91 encoding and decoding.
repos.what_it_does: Provides Base91 encoding and decoding functionality, including a separate streaming module, for Kotlin Multiplatform projects.

repos.name: bee-do
repos.one_liner: A deployable capture-to-Slack tracer that sends annotated browser screenshots and bounded page diagnostics through a Cloudflare Worker.
techniques: Versioned TypeScript and Zod data contracts
Slack Web API channel creation, invitations, messages, and file uploads
Stable error codes with retry guidance
Type checking, linting, formatting, coverage testing, and production builds
repos.what_it_does: A Chrome Manifest V3 extension captures the visible viewport on approved sites, lets a requester add pen and text annotations, collects limited console and click context, and submits a versioned multipart Capture to an authenticated Cloudflare Worker API. The Worker validates size and schema constraints, creates a public Slack request channel, invites the requester and configured reviewers, posts a summary, and uploads the annotated screenshot and diagnostics. Captures are stateless, retries may create duplicate or partial channels, and requester Slack identity is self-asserted.

repos.name: beeswax-api
repos.one_liner: Python project with insufficient evidence to determine its purpose.
repos.what_it_does: No README, description, topics, or notable files document the project's capabilities; only a Python source directory is evidenced.

repos.name: betapert
repos.one_liner: A typed Python implementation of classic and modified PERT probability distributions compatible with SciPy.
repos.what_it_does: Provides SciPy rv_continuous-style PERT and modified PERT distributions for modeling uncertain quantities from minimum, mode, and maximum estimates. It supports probability and sampling methods, parameter broadcasting, maximum-likelihood fitting with fixed lambda, closed-form statistics and moments, degenerate boundary modes, and fallback quantile solving for extreme probabilities.

repos.name: bifrost
repos.one_liner: High-performance enterprise AI gateway that unifies multiple model providers behind an OpenAI-compatible API.
techniques: Load balancing across providers and API keys
Semantic response caching with vector storage
Rate limiting, virtual keys, budgets, and access control
Prometheus metrics, distributed tracing, and request logging
repos.what_it_does: Routes text, image, audio, and streaming AI requests across 23+ providers, with automatic fallbacks, load balancing, semantic caching, MCP tool access, governance, observability, and configurable web-based administration. It supports HTTP gateway deployment, embedded Go SDK integration, and drop-in replacement endpoints for existing AI SDKs.

repos.name: browser-ai-dev-agent
repos.one_liner: Visual AI development toolkit that turns browser-selected UI change requests into verified source-code patches.
techniques: DOM, CSS selector, XPath, computed-style, screenshot, and console-log capture
Structured JSON output and unified-diff parsing
HTTP health probes and build-log regex checks
repos.what_it_does: A Chrome Manifest V3 extension captures selected-element DOM context, screenshots, console logs, and a developer prompt, then sends them to a Node.js orchestrator. The service queues work per project, invokes the Claude Code CLI, applies generated patches with Git, restarts and checks the local build, persists run artifacts in SQLite, and streams status to the extension popup and DevTools panel.

repos.name: browser-history-refindery
repos.one_liner: A macOS CLI that imports browser history into a Refindery backend.
techniques: Dry-run storage and indexing cost estimation
repos.what_it_does: Discovers Safari, Firefox, Chrome, and compatible Chromium profiles, reads snapshot copies of their history databases, applies local privacy exclusions, and submits eligible URLs through an incremental, resumable pipeline. It supports dry runs with storage and indexing cost estimates and stores local progress and deduplication state in SQLite.

repos.name: catching-jit-tests-vitest
repos.one_liner: Experimental TypeScript CLI and library that generates just-in-time Vitest tests to detect behavioral changes across Git revisions.
techniques: Dual-revision execution in temporary Git worktrees
Flake detection through repeated parent runs
repos.what_it_does: Analyzes TypeScript diffs, scores their risk, uses configurable LLM providers to generate focused Vitest tests, and executes those tests in temporary parent and child Git worktrees. It identifies tests that pass on the parent but fail on the child, filters likely false positives through rules and LLM judging, retains passing tests as hardening candidates, and produces console, JSON, GitHub comment, or step-summary reports. It also supports feedback triage and calibration of assessment weights.

repos.name: chrome-extension-airflow
repos.one_liner: Chrome extension that improves the Apache Airflow web interface with automated refresh and workflow controls.
techniques: Automatic page refresh based on page state and scroll position
repos.what_it_does: Enhances Airflow log and tree pages by refreshing logs when scrolled to the bottom, refreshing tree views while tasks are running, redirecting after manual DAG triggers, and adding a Trigger button to tree pages.

repos.name: chrome-extension-boox-push-booxdrop
repos.one_liner: A Manifest V3 boilerplate for Chromium browser extensions.
repos.what_it_does: Adds a browser toolbar button that opens a popup. Clicking the popup button injects a script into the active tab, adds an orange div displaying “DOM modified!” at the top of the page, and logs an action message to the developer console.

repos.name: chrome-extension-fuck-nestle
repos.one_liner: Chrome extension that warns shoppers before purchasing products associated with Nestlé.
repos.what_it_does: Identifies and warns about Nestlé-brand products while users shop on Amazon, Instacart, Target, and Walmart. It uses a brand list sourced from Fuck Nestlé and BlueTriton and is installed manually as an unpacked Chrome extension.

repos.name: chrome-extension-github-pr-notifications
repos.one_liner: Browser extension that notifies users about GitHub pull request activity and synchronizes pull requests into bookmarks.
techniques: Background service worker and scheduled alarms
Local browser settings and token storage
repos.what_it_does: Monitors open GitHub pull request tabs for CI status changes, comments, inline review comments, and reviews, then displays clickable desktop notifications that focus the relevant tab. It also uses the GitHub GraphQL API to periodically synchronize selected pull requests into a chosen bookmark folder, marks their states with colored emoji, presents them in a toolbar popup, and shows a badge count for failing pull requests. Options control notification events, synchronization filters and frequency, result limits, icon style, and GitHub Enterprise hosts.

repos.name: chrome-extension-jira-bookmarks-sync
repos.one_liner: Chrome extension that synchronizes Jira issues with browser bookmarks.
repos.what_it_does: It creates bookmarks for Jira issues and organizes them into status folders. Moving an issue bookmark between status folders automatically transitions the corresponding issue in Jira.

repos.name: chrome-extension-r2j2-blocker
repos.one_liner: A Chrome extension that gates distracting websites behind recent keyword-matching journal entries.
techniques: Chrome sync, session, and local storage
repos.what_it_does: Checks configured URL patterns during full-page and single-page-app navigation, fetches timestamped journal entries from an R2J2-compatible CSV endpoint, and allows access only when a configured keyword appears within the valid timeframe. It redirects failed checks, displays per-tab access badges, caches journal responses, supports optional per-domain unlock limits, imports and exports settings, and stores pruned local activity summaries.

repos.name: chrome-forecast
repos.one_liner: Chrome extension that displays Forecast.io weather in a popup and shows sunrise or sunset time on its icon.
repos.what_it_does: Provides a browser-extension popup sourced from Forecast.io and calculates sun position to display sunrise or sunset time on the extension icon.

repos.name: chrome-session-to-report
repos.one_liner: Chrome SNSS session and tab file parser that generates a self-contained HTML report.
techniques: File version classification by numeric suffix
repos.what_it_does: Reads Chrome Session_* and Tabs_* SNSS files from a local data directory and produces report.html with open windows, tab restore state, pinned and active-tab details, and full navigation histories. The report labels older and newer files as Last and Current and provides collapsible window and tab sections with URLs, titles, timestamps, transition types, referrers, and HTTP status codes.

repos.name: chrome-tab-extractor
repos.one_liner: A Chrome and Firefox extension that extracts matching tabs into a new window.
repos.what_it_does: It searches open tabs by title or URL from the address bar and moves matches into a new window. It supports whole-phrase searches, excluded terms, exclusion-only searches, domain-based extraction from a context menu, and preservation of pinned-tab status.

repos.name: circleci-android-java-17
repos.one_liner: A CircleCI Android Docker image extended with Java 17.
techniques: Java 17 runtime and development kit provisioning
repos.what_it_does: Builds on the cimg-android image and provides Java JDK/JRE 17 for Android build environments.

repos.name: cloudflare-email-worker-sqlite
repos.one_liner: Cloudflare Email Worker that stores incoming emails in a SQLite-compatible D1 database.
repos.what_it_does: Receives emails through Cloudflare Email Routing and persists them to a configured Cloudflare D1 database. It is installed with Yarn, configured using database ID and name environment variables, and deployed with Wrangler.

repos.name: cloudflare-realtime-workers-wiki
repos.one_liner: A private, self-hosted collaborative wiki running on Cloudflare's edge platform.
techniques: Debounced and chunked SQLite update logs
HTTP range and conditional ETag handling
End-to-end, integration, unit, coverage, and load testing
repos.what_it_does: Provides authenticated workspace and page management with realtime collaborative documents and diagrams, presence, comments, mentions, notifications, search, attachments, versioning, structured tables, imports, and resumable exports. It uses Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, D1, R2, Workflows, and queues, with a React client built around BlockNote, React Flow, and Yjs. Documents support offline IndexedDB persistence, while diagrams require an authoritative live connection. Optional Slack integration supports search, unfurls, channel mappings, and notifications.

repos.name: codex-eink-boox
repos.one_liner: Experimental monochrome Android client for monitoring and controlling Codex workflows on BOOX e-ink devices.
repos.what_it_does: Provides an e-ink-optimized task list and timeline for Codex messages, plans, reasoning summaries, commands, file changes, tools, web activity, errors, approvals, and questions. It supports inline approval decisions, QR or manual pairing, encrypted credential storage, background reconnection and notifications, boot recovery, experimental managed-relay framing, and direct authenticated WebSocket connections for app-server protocol and UI diagnostics. Managed Remote controller support remains compatibility-gated, and direct mode does not co-control an existing Codex Desktop task.

repos.name: comparison-S3-Compatible-Object-Storage-Alternatives
repos.one_liner: A documented comparison of S3-compatible and adjacent object-storage services.
repos.what_it_does: Compares hosted and self-managed object-storage options across pricing, free tiers, egress, retention limits, regions, API compatibility, IPFS support, durability, performance, encryption, access control, and lifecycle management, with claims linked to provider references.

repos.name: comparison-e2ee-chat-providers
repos.one_liner: Evidence-backed comparison of chat infrastructure providers with built-in or client-side end-to-end encryption options.
repos.what_it_does: Documents and compares QuickBlox, MirrorFly, CometChat, Pusher, Ably, Agora, and PubNub across encryption, messaging features, UI SDKs, pricing, moderation, analytics, SLAs, compliance, HIPAA support, company metrics, key management, bots, observability, scale, serverless functions, and message limits. It explains its E2EE grading criteria, records notable provider changes from 2024–2026, and cites vendor documentation and other sources for the comparison.

repos.name: comparison-hosts-serverless-cloud-function-faas-for-python
repos.one_liner: A sourced comparison guide for hosted Python serverless function and scale-to-zero platforms.
repos.what_it_does: Compares Python-capable FaaS, serverless container, and scale-to-zero hosting providers across developer experience, runtime support, pricing, limits, platform status, regions, and related products. It distinguishes edge from regional execution, documents recent platform changes, identifies excluded or emerging providers, and links to official sources and examples.

repos.name: comparison-serverless-cloud-sql-databases
repos.one_liner: A detailed reference comparing hosted serverless SQL database providers that can scale to zero.
repos.what_it_does: Documents and compares provider developer experience, SQL dialects, connection methods, open-source status, free and paid pricing, runtime and database limits, cloud platforms, and community support, with links to official sources and notes about removed or discontinued offerings.

repos.name: comparison-unified-inbox-for-small-teams
repos.one_liner: Comparison guide for unified inbox and related customer communication services aimed at small and midsize businesses.
repos.what_it_does: Documents and compares products across major features, advantages, disadvantages, API availability, and pricing, with links to products, API documentation, and research sources.

repos.name: comparison-web-app-authentication-providers
repos.one_liner: A reference guide comparing authentication providers for web and mobile applications.
repos.what_it_does: Compares hosted and self-hosted authentication providers across pricing, supported features, recommended use cases, and developer experience. It covers capabilities such as OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SSO, MFA, passkeys, social login, RBAC, user management, and backend-service integration, with links to providers, open-source projects, and supporting references.

repos.name: connectbot
repos.one_liner: Android SSH client for securely connecting to remote servers.
repos.what_it_does: Provides an Android terminal application that connects to remote servers over cryptographically secured SSH links. It uses a dedicated terminal emulator and a modified Trilead SSH-2 library, and is distributed through Google Play and GitHub release APKs.

repos.name: conversation-notes
repos.one_liner: Privacy-focused iOS app for capturing and structuring medical scientific exchanges.
repos.what_it_does: Records in-person exchanges between Medical Science Liaisons and healthcare professionals, transcribes conversation audio on-device, creates a compliance-safe prose summary through a provider-neutral service boundary, and deletes the source audio and transcript according to a defined lifecycle. It also conducts linked or standalone structured voice interviews using text-to-speech and speech-to-text, requiring adverse-event, off-label, and other fixed-schema fields before completion. Summaries, consent utterances, and interview artifacts remain stored locally, with encrypted temporary transcript storage and launch-time crash recovery.

repos.name: cordova-plugin-firebase-realtime-database
repos.one_liner: Cordova plugin providing native access to Google Firebase Realtime Database and email/password authentication.
repos.what_it_does: Exposes a JavaScript API for obtaining database path references, updating child keys, setting values, enabling on-disk persistence, and signing in with an email and password. It supports iOS and Android Firebase configuration files and uses an after-prepare hook to copy them into platform-specific locations.

repos.name: create-trio-app
repos.one_liner: A standalone CLI generator for production-oriented Next.js modular-monolith projects.
repos.what_it_does: Scaffolds Next.js applications with strict TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, modular architecture, UI primitives, Vitest, and Sheriff architecture guardrails. It can also add and register modules with domain, application, infrastructure, and transport layers, while supporting dry runs, forced overwrites, and optional dependency installation, database generation, and Git initialization.

repos.name: create-ts-lib
repos.one_liner: An opinionated CLI and API for scaffolding modern, publish-ready TypeScript libraries.
